channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Spam Airdrop Tokens: Which Wallet Actions Put Funds at Risk
item.description: What happens if you interact with a spam airdrop token? Receiving or viewing is usually harmless; signing, approving or trading can put assets at risk.

item.title: ERC-7683: How fillers read cross-chain orders
item.description: What is the ERC-7683 cross-chain intents standard? It gives intent protocols a shared order format and solver interface, while leaving settlement proof to each protocol.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Bridge Between Layer 2s? Plan Your Wait
item.description: How long does it take to bridge between Layer 2s? Fast relayer routes can settle in seconds to minutes; CCTP standard transfers take about 15–20 minutes.

item.title: Native USDC reaches Arbitrum through a wallet bridge
item.description: How to move USDC from Polygon to Arbitrum without an exchange: connect MetaMask to a USDC bridge, send native USDC, and receive it at the same address.

item.title: How to Connect a Phone Wallet to a Desktop dApp
item.description: Learn how to connect a mobile wallet to a desktop dApp with WalletConnect: scan the QR code, approve the session, then sign each transaction on your phone.

item.title: Aave lending and Umbrella staking: the risk and return trade-off
item.description: Aave lending vs Umbrella staking: supply earns interest; staking adds rewards but exposes aTokens to slashing and cooldowns, so reserve it for idle, non-collateral funds.

item.title: Aave Safety Module and Ethereum Validator Slashing
item.description: Safety module staking vs validator staking slashing comes down to trigger and control: validator faults are rare, while a crash-driven backstop loss can be larger.

item.title: TVL when choosing a lending vault: deposits and exit room
item.description: Does TVL matter when choosing a lending vault? Somewhat: it signals depositor trust and exit room, but liquidity, utilization, allocations and concentration give a clearer view.

item.title: Why does my Base fee include an L1 data fee?
item.description: Why does my Base transaction fee include an L1 data fee? It pays for publishing compressed transaction data to Ethereum; size and Ethereum fees move the cost.

item.title: cBridge Token Transfers Through SGN Validation
item.description: cBridge tutorial for moving tokens between chains: connect your wallet, approve a supported token, confirm the transfer and check its arrival on the destination.

item.title: Base fee vs priority fee: fix a slow Ethereum transaction
item.description: Base fee vs priority fee: raise maxFeePerGas when it misses Ethereum’s base fee, or maxPriorityFeePerGas when the tip is too low to get included.

item.title: Intent-based swaps cut sandwich risk; approvals still matter
item.description: Is cowswap safer than Uniswap? For routine swaps, it usually lowers sandwich risk through batch auctions; approvals, phishing and fake tokens remain your responsibility.

item.title: EU proposes crypto crackdown in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would extend transaction bans to 60 banks and target crypto networks, including third-country enablers.

item.title: How to refinance a DeFi loan without a liquidation
item.description: To refinance a DeFi loan to a lower interest rate, compare rates at your debt size, move collateral in chunks or one transaction, then confirm the old loan is closed.

item.title: Can I safely swap an airdropped ERC-20 token on a DEX?
item.description: You can sometimes swap airdropped tokens safely on a DEX, but verify the token contract and wallet prompt first; an unsolicited deposit is no proof of legitimacy.

item.title: Move on Sui: How Its Rules Protect Coins
item.description: What is the Move language on Sui? Move is a resource-safe smart-contract language; Sui Move organizes assets as objects with explicit ownership.

item.title: Does speeding up a pending Gnosis Bridge deposit change it?
item.description: Speeding up a pending bridge transaction keeps its token, amount and recipient unchanged; MetaMask raises the fee, and the mined replacement has a new hash.

item.title: Choose a DEX for a Swap That Clears Safely and Cheaply
item.description: What to check before choosing a DEX for a swap: compare network and token support, total cost after fees, MEV protection and slippage for the trade you plan to make.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles team for AI and quantum security
item.description: The Ethereum Foundation doubled its protocol security team and put hash-based cryptography first, citing AI as a more urgent risk than quantum computing.

item.title: Token Address Checks: CoinGecko and Etherscan
item.description: To verify a token contract, use project docs for the starting address, CoinGecko to match its chain, and Etherscan to inspect the deployed contract.
